name: SMS phishing · unfamiliar debit
text: I received a text message claiming to be SYN Bank A. I opened the link and entered my banking password and a one-time code. Later I noticed an unfamiliar AUD 2,000 debit. I do not know whether it is pending or completed. I have the message on my phone and have not contacted the bank or mobile provider yet.

name: Missing information · payment request
text: Someone claiming to be a supplier emailed new payment details. I may have sent a payment, but I need to check the amount and whether it went through. I still have the email.

name: Limited information · support needed
text: I am worried about repeated calls from someone asking me to act quickly. I feel overwhelmed and do not know what to do. I have not shared details of the calls yet.
